description: A single witness verdict on a kotoba-datomic record's membrane conformance. Produced by a Pregel cell selected via hash(record_cid) % len(fleet.cells) per kotoba-datomic SPEC §5. ≥3-of-5 matching attestations (default quorum) make the target record kotoba-datomic-L1-witnessed. Per ADR-2605231400.

recordUri.description: AT URI of the record being attested. Format: at://{did}/{collection}/{rkey}.

recordCid.description: Content identifier of the record being attested. Used for membrane evaluation reproducibility and as the input to hash(record_cid) % N_cells witness selection.

cellId.description: Murakumo Pregel cell ID that produced this attestation. Must match an entry in 50-infra/murakumo/fleet.toml cells. Format: PascalCase (e.g., 'TitheRoutingCell', 'CharterAttestationRequestCell').

verdict.description: The cell's verdict on whether the record passes its kotoba-datomic-membrane (Lexicon schema + Rego policy + LangGraph determinism check).

reason.description: Free-form reason. Required when verdict is 'reject' or 'escalate'. Audit-grade — surfaced in Council deliberation when escalation fires.

membraneVersion.description: Composite version string for the (Lexicon schema, Rego policy, LangGraph cell code) triple this attestation was computed against. Format: 'lex:{semver}/rego:{semver}/cell:{git-sha-7}'. Enables re-attestation when the membrane evolves.

signature.description: Cell-key signature over canonicalized (recordCid + cellId + verdict + reason + membraneVersion + attestedAt). Verified against the cell's published verification key in fleet.toml. Key rotation cadence: 90 days (fleet.cell_key_rotation_period_days).

quorumGroup.description: The 5-cell selection group this attestation belongs to. Computed as sha256(recordCid)[:16]. All 5 attestations for the same record share the same quorumGroup, enabling quorum collection by primary-key lookup.

escalationTarget.description: Required when verdict is 'escalate'. Names the escalation path: 'council' (Council Lv6+ ≥3 multisig per ADR-2605192300), 'membrane-amendment' (proposed Lexicon / Rego / cell-code change), or 'human-review' (operator intervention).
